thought.text: Core workflow step (create Verfahren) works. Let me test the FCS template endpoints which drive the formal completeness check.

reasoning_content:
Excellent! Creating a Verfahren works end-to-end (HTTP 201, persisted, retrievable). This is the first step of the documented workflow. Let me also test the FCS initialize step maybe, but that may need more setup. The core validation is strong.

Let me verify the FCS "required-document-types/initialize" to confirm the formal completeness service can be initialized for a project. That's part of the workflow. Actually the workflow requires an LLM and Docling at KI-Analyse; those are placeholders. But document extraction requires Docling which is absent, expected.

Let me test the FCS initialize endpoint for the created project—it uses seeded template categories.

Let me check what the frontend does: after creating Verfahren, the FCS template categories. Let me just confirm template-categories endpoint returns data for project type.

Let me test the /{project_type_id}/template-categories.
